title: microgramma brunei
intro: Microgramma brunei, commonly known as the "Brunei Shield Fern," is a species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. The Brunei Shield Fern has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The Brunei Shield Fern contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
